title: Northgate Store and Online Orders — Changed-Mind Refund at Drive Up, Computation
content:
**Standard method.** For an electronics-class line of a Northgate Same-Day Delivery order of **Northgate Store and Online Orders** returned at a Drive Up because the customer changed their mind, the standard changed-mind refund is the line's net amount as charged, less a standard restocking fee of ten percent (10 percent) of that net amount, rounded half up to the cent. The line's net amount as charged is the net amount paid for that line before tax.

**Assembly.** The changed-mind refund is the refund basis, which is the line's net amount as charged, less the restocking fee. The restocking fee is the line's net amount as charged multiplied once by the sum of the restocking percentages on the return, the line's restocking percentage of ten percent together with any restocking addition, less any restocking relief, rounded half up to the cent and never below zero; the refund is rounded half up to the cent and is never below zero. Every count of calendar days in this computation leaves out the day it starts from and includes the day it ends on.

**Worked figure (hypothetical line).**

| Step | Amount |
|---|---|
| line's net amount as charged | 240.00 |
| restocking fee, 10 percent of 240.00 | 24.00 |
| changed-mind refund, 240.00 less 24.00 | 216.00 |
